name: Seongsu Cafe & Shopping Walk
summary: A half-day walk through Seongsu combining signature cafes, shopping streets, pop-up culture and industrial-style spaces.
description: This route is designed for first-time visitors who want to experience the modern side of Seongsu in a compact half day. It moves through cafe, shopping and warehouse-style spaces around the neighborhood's main streets.

stops.note: Start with coffee in one of Seongsu's best-known industrial-style cafe spaces.
Walk Yeonmujang-gil and explore side streets, boutiques and current pop-ups.
Take a break at a multi-use cafe and retail space.
Experience Seongsu's warehouse-regeneration style in a large cultural cafe space.
Finish near Seongsu Station with a contemporary footwear and fashion stop.

name: Slow Seongsu Local Walk
summary: A relaxed Seongsu route mixing Seoul Forest, a quiet cafe, local food and the neighborhood's shoe-making heritage.
description: This route avoids a purely trend-focused itinerary and combines greenery, quieter cafe time, local food and Seongsu's long connection to footwear production. It suits travelers who want a slower neighborhood experience.

stops.note: Begin with a relaxed walk through Seoul Forest.
Take a quieter cafe break near Seoul Forest.
Stop for a more traditional local meal in Seongsu.
Explore the neighborhood's long-standing handmade shoe district.
Finish with a contemporary Korean footwear brand connected to Seongsu's shoe culture.

name: Seongsu Beauty & Fashion Route
summary: A half-day Seongsu route focused on K-beauty, footwear, fashion retail and the neighborhood's trend-driven shopping streets.
description: This route is for travelers interested in contemporary Korean beauty and fashion. It connects an experiential beauty space with footwear-focused stores and Seongsu's main shopping streets.

stops.note: Start with a K-beauty experience in a renovated Seongsu space.
Browse contemporary Korean footwear near Seongsu Station.
Compare modern Korean footwear design with Seongsu's traditional shoe-making identity.
Finish by exploring boutiques, concept stores and current pop-ups around Yeonmujang-gil.
